name: Robots.txt Blocking Important Pages
description: robots.txt accidentally blocks important content pages.
userMessage: My new product pages aren't showing up in Google at all. The site is example.com. Can you help figure out why?
expectedBehavior: Runs analyze_robots_txt first to check crawlability
Identifies Disallow rule blocking the product pages
Explains that blocked pages cannot be indexed
Suggests also checking for noindex meta tags on the pages
